1: // Simple endless vertical scrolling game "Sky Diver"
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 400;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Player (parachuter)
11:   const player = { x: width / 2, y: height - 50, w: 30, h: 30, speed: 4 };
12: 
13:   // Game objects
14:   const obstacles = [];
15:   const coins = [];
16:   let score = 0;
17:   let gameOver = false;
18: 
19:   // Input handling
20:   const keys = {};
21:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
22:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
23: 
24:   function spawnObstacle() {
25:     const size = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
26:     obstacles.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
27:   }
28:   function spawnCoin() {
29:     const size = 15;
30:     coins.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, r: size / 2, speed: 2 });
31:   }
32: 
33:   let obstacleTimer = 0, coinTimer = 0;
34: 
35:   function update() {
36:     if (gameOver) return;
37:     // Player movement
38:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= player.speed;
39:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += player.speed;
40:     // Clamp
41:     if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
42:     if (player.x + player.w > width) player.x = width - player.w;
43: 
44:     // Spawn obstacles/coins
45:     obstacleTimer++;
46:     coinTimer++;
47:     if (obstacleTimer > 90) { spawnObstacle(); obstacleTimer = 0; }
48:     if (coinTimer > 150) { spawnCoin(); coinTimer = 0; }
49: 
50:     // Move obstacles
51:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
52:       const o = obstacles[i];
53:       o.y += o.speed;
54:       if (o.y > height) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
55:       // Collision with player
56:       if (rectIntersect(player, o)) { gameOver = true; }
57:     }
58:     // Move coins
59:     for (let i = coins.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
60:       const c = coins[i];
61:       c.y += c.speed;
62:       if (c.y > height) { coins.splice(i, 1); continue; }
63:       if (circleRectIntersect(c, player)) { score++; coins.splice(i, 1); }
64:     }
65:   }
66: 
67:   function draw() {
68:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
69:     // Player (simple parachute shape)
70:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
71:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
72:     // Obstacles (birds/balloons as red squares)
73:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
74:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
75:     // Coins
76:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
77:     coins.forEach(c => {
78:       ctx.beginPath();
79:       ctx.arc(c.x + c.r, c.y + c.r, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
80:       ctx.fill();
81:     });
82:     // Score
83:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
84:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
85:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
86:     if (gameOver) {
87:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
88:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
89:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
90:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
91:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
92:     }
93:   }
94: 
95:   function loop() {
96:     update();
97:     draw();
98:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
99:   }
100:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
101: 
102:   // Helper collision functions
103:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
104:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
105:   }
106:   function circleRectIntersect(c, r) {
107:     const distX = Math.abs(c.x + c.r - (r.x + r.w / 2));
108:     const distY = Math.abs(c.y + c.r - (r.y + r.h / 2));
109:     if (distX > (r.w / 2 + c.r)) return false;
110:     if (distY > (r.h / 2 + c.r)) return false;
111:     if (distX <= (r.w / 2)) return true;
112:     if (distY <= (r.h / 2)) return true;
113:     const dx = distX - r.w / 2;
114:     const dy = distY - r.h / 2;
115:     return (dx * dx + dy * dy <= (c.r * c.r));
116:   }
117: })();
